## What changed

Describe the digital-marketing or engineering problem and the bounded solution.

## Evidence

List tests run and distinguish supplied facts, inferences, assumptions, and missing evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added a failing test before each behavior change and verified the fix.
- [ ] Full tests, coverage, Ruff, mypy, build, and privacy scan pass locally.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are fictional and contain no credentials or personal data.
- [ ] SEO, AEO, and GEO are described accurately and not treated as synonyms.
- [ ] Documentation makes no unsupported ranking, citation, traffic, lead, revenue, diversity, or accuracy claim.
- [ ] Provider/network/cost and platform-specific output behavior are documented when affected.
